newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates stay high on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates stay high on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates traded at higher levels on Saturday amid a persistent shortage of liquidity and are expected to remain firm on Sunday, dealers said.

Overnight funds remained steady at the 20 percent market throughout the day, a dealer at KASB & Co said. Some banks approached the State (central) Bank of Pakistan to avail of its discounting facility.
The rates are likely to stay firm as no inflows are expected to hit the market in the next few days, the dealer said.
